name: @arp/node
description: The agent node: listens at the address an agent publishes, checks on chain that the requester paid, and signs a receipt. Signs no transaction.

scripts.start: bun run --cwd ../../packages/protocol build && bun run src/node.ts
scripts.build: bun run --cwd ../../packages/protocol build && bun build src/node.ts --outdir dist --entry-naming 'arp-[name].js' --target=bun --external viem --external 'viem/*' --banner '#!/usr/bin/env bun'
